subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Gentlemen always go for a __lawful__ approach, but rouges choose ______ ways to solve problems.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lawful"** means something that is permitted by law; legal or legitimate. (कानूनी)

 
 
• **Example:** The company ensures that all its operations are** lawful** and transparent.
 
 
 
• **"Illicit"** refers to something that is forbidden by law, rules, or custom; illegal. (गैरकानूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The police cracked down on the **illicit **trade of endangered species.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the** opposite** of **'lawful'** is **'illicit'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sophisticated** (परिष्कृत): Having a refined knowledge of the world or culture.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a **sophisticated** taste in art and music.
 
 
 
• **Legitimate** (वैध): Conforming to the law or to rules.
 
 
• **Example:** The company has a** legitimate** claim to the property.
 
 
 
• **Legal** (कानूनी): Relating to the law.
 
 
• **Example:** He sought** legal **advice before signing the contract.
